testCase.name: XML Layout Inflation
testCase.description: Runtime inflation error due to unknown attribute

error.message: Binary XML file line #12: Error inflating class android.widget.TextView

expectedFix.explanation: Remove invalid attribute or use android:textStyle="bold"

agent_response.error: Binary XML file line #12: Error inflating class android.widget.TextView
agent_response.rootCause: Error inflating class android.widget.TextView at file:app/src/main/res/layout/activity_main.xml line #12
fixGuidelines: 1. Ensure that TextView has a proper XML inflation constructor with (Context, AttributeSet?) signature.
2. Verify that the TextView is correctly defined in the layout file and its XML attributes are properly handled.
3. Check if the TextView class is public or internal and adjust accordingly.
4. Add necessary ProGuard rules to keep the TextView class during minification.
5. Ensure that the activity_main.xml file uses the correct constructor for inflating TextView.
6. Verify that all attributes in the XML layout are correctly mapped and match the expected constructors.
7. Test each change incrementally to identify which part of the fix resolves the issue.
